name: gaapweb-jobs-scraper
title: GAAPweb API: UK Accountancy Job Recruitment Data
description: Scrape accountancy and finance job listings from GAAPweb.com, the UK job board: title, employer, location, salary, posting age and, on request, the full text, contract, hours and workplace. Pay-per-result.
readme:
# GAAPweb Jobs Scraper Scrape job listings from GAAPweb ([gaapweb.com](https://www.gaapweb.com/)), the UK job board for accountancy and finance. You get the title, employer, location, salary text with parsed amounts when the advertiser states a period, the age of the listing, the closing countdown and the New and Featured badges for every job. Turn on the job page option to add the full description, the exact posting and closing time, the employer page, categories, experience levels, contract, hours and workplace. Search by keyword and the site's own filters (location, job function, sector, experience, job type, workplace), or start from any GAAPweb jobs address. ## What you get - One row per job, with parsed salary numbers (from and up to, in GBP) when the salary text names a period such as per annum, per hour or per day. - Optional job page details: exact posting and closing time, full description as HTML and plain text, employer page, reference, recruiter type, categories, experience levels, contract types, hours, workplaces and salary bands. These columns are filled only with the job page option on (detail-only columns). - Each job once per run, even when several keywords find it. - A run with an input that has none of the fields below returns 5 jobs for the keyword controller. ## Use with AI Agents (MCP) Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client: Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents. **Apify MCP server URL:** `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/gaapweb-jobs-scraper` **Example prompt once connected:** > "Use `gaapweb-jobs-scraper` to find up to 5 jobs for the keyword "controller" (financial controller jobs in the UK). Return results as a table with title, company, location and job URL." Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) receive the full input schema automatically. ## Input Every field is optional. Example: ```json { "includeDetails": false, "maxResults": 5, "maxResultsPerQuery": 5, "searchQueries": [ "controller" ] } ``` | Field | What it does | |---|---| | `searchQueries` | Keywords such as controller, audit senior, payroll or tax manager. Each keyword is its own search. Leave empty to read the newest jobs. | | `startUrls` | GAAPweb addresses: `https://www.gaapweb.com/jobs/` or `https://www.gaapweb.com/jobs/greater-manchester/payroll/?Keywords=officer`. Only the Keywords parameter is kept. A `/searchjobs/` address with only Keywords is read as `/jobs/?Keywords=...`; any other `/searchjobs/` address is skipped with a warning, because the site's robots.txt disallows `/searchjobs/`. Reading starts at page 1. Disallowed facet paths (`/jobs/permanent/`, `/jobs/full-time/`, `/jobs/recruitment-agency/`, `/jobs/direct-employer/`, salary band paths) and `sort=` addresses are rejected with a message in the run status. | | `locations` | Region slugs: `london-greater-`, `greater-manchester`, `hampshire`, `east-midlands-region`, `east-of-england`, `europe`, `north-west-england`, `south-east-england`, `south-west-england`, `west-midlands-region`. `london` and `greater london` are accepted for `london-greater-`, `manchester` for `greater-manchester`. | | `jobFunctions` | `finance-manager`, `accountant`, `accounts-assistant`, `acca`, `accounts-payable`, `audit`, `bookkeeper`, `credit-controller`, `payroll`, `tax`. | | `sectors` | `accountancy-practice`, `banking-and-financial-services`, `business-services`, `charity`, `construction`, `consultancy-services`, `insurance`, `manufacturing-engineering`, `retail-wholesale`, `transport-logistics`. | | `experienceLevels` | `entry-level`, `newly-qualified`, `qualified-accountant`, `manager`, `director`, `part-qualified-1`. | | `jobTypes` | `contract`, `temporary`, `part-time`. | | `workplaces` | `hybrid`, `on-site`, `remote`. | | `maxResultsPerQuery` | Jobs per keyword or start URL. Default 50, up to 1000. | | `maxResults` | Jobs in total. 0 means no limit. | | `includeDetails` | Read each job page for the extra fields. Default false. Same price. | The filters are the path slugs of the site's browse list, for example `/jobs/greater-manchester/payroll/hybrid/?Keywords=officer`. The site lists only its top links per filter, so the fields take free text: a value is lower-cased, spaces and `&` become `-`, and only letters, digits and `-` are kept. The slugs above are the ones seen on the site; others may work. Every request uses this browse path; the actor never requests `/searchjobs/`, which the site's robots.txt disallows. Slugs the robots.txt disallows (permanent, full-time, recruitment-agency, direct-employer, salary bands) are skipped with one warning each and never requested. One search runs per keyword and per combination of one value from each filter you fill (at most 60 searches per run). When all values of a filter are skipped, the run reads nothing and ends with 0 jobs. Examples: ```json { "searchQueries": ["payroll"], "locations": ["Manchester"], "maxResults": 30 } ``` ```json { "jobFunctions": ["payroll"], "workplaces": ["hybrid"] } ``` ## Sample output ```json { "id": "4330168", "title": "Interim Financial Controller", "slug": "interim-financial-controller", "company": "Hays Accountancy and Finance", "company_id": "b9647f5c-bc1a-4385-b4ae-e214ffdaec1d", "company_url": "https://www.gaapweb.com/employer/b9647f5c-bc1a-4385-b4ae-e214ffdaec1d/hays-accountancy-and-finance", "company_logo": "https://www.gaapweb.com/getasset/dde5cbb9-de0c-484d-89a2-f24c7b0a90a0/;w=148", "location": "England, Hampshire, Farnborough", "city": "Farnborough", "region": "Hampshire", "country_code": "GB", "location_terms": [ "Hampshire", "South East England", "England", "United Kingdom", "Europe", "Farnborough" ], "salary_text": "Competitive", "salary_min": null, "salary_max": null, "salary_period": null, "salary_currency": null, "salary_bands": [ "£80,000 - £89,999", "£90,000 - £99,999", "£100,000 - £109,999" ], "description_short": "Interim Financial Controller, 3 - 6 months; Preparation of monthly management accounts, variance analysis, forecasts and budgets.", "description_html": "

Your new company

You will join an established international technology and manufacturing organisation...", "description_text": "Your new company\n\nYou will join an established international technology and manufacturing organisation. The business combines a global presence with strong regional operations...", "posted_text": null, "posted_date_estimated": null, "closing_text": "6 days left", "closing_date_estimated": "2026-11-17", "date_posted": "2026-10-20T20:25:00.000Z", "valid_through": "2026-11-17T21:25:00.000Z", "is_new": false, "is_featured": false, "reference": "4839105", "external_job_id": "5503644268", "recruiter_id": "9374", "recruiter_type": "Recruitment Agency", "application_method": "Email", "listing_type": "Job Posting Standard 28 Days", "direct_apply": true, "employment_types": [ "TEMPORARY", "FULL_TIME" ], "categories": [ "Manufacturing / Engineering" ], "experience_levels": [ "Qualified Accountant" ], "contract_types": [ "Temporary" ], "hours": [ "Full Time" ], "job_titles": [ "Financial Controller" ], "workplaces": [ "Hybrid" ], "job_url": "https://www.gaapweb.com/job/4330168/interim-financial-controller/", "details_fetched": true, "search_query": "controller", "source": "gaapweb.com", "scraped_at": "2026-11-11T12:00:00Z" } ``` ## Fields | Field | Type | Description | |---|---|---| | `id` | string | Numeric job id: the number in the job address /job///. It is the dedup key. | | `title` | string | Job title as shown on the listing. | | `slug` | string, null | Text part of the job address. | | `company` | string, null | Employer or recruiter name as shown on the listing. | | `company_id` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Id of the employer page (the uuid in /employer//). | | `company_url` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Employer profile page on GAAPweb. | | `company_logo` | string, null | Logo image URL of the employer. | | `location` | string, null | Location text as shown (country, county, town). | | `city` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Town from the job posting data. | | `region` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). County or region from the job posting data. | | `country_code` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Country code from the job posting data. | | `location_terms` | array | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Location hierarchy terms of the job, from the specific county up to the continent. Empty when the page has none. | | `salary_text` | string, null | Salary as typed by the advertiser, for example 'Competitive' or '£55000.0 - £60000.0 per annum + bonus'. | | `salary_min` | number, null | Lower bound in GBP, read only from a text with a stated period (per annum, hour, day, week, month). Null otherwise. | | `salary_max` | number, null | Upper bound in GBP, read only from a text with a stated period. 'Up to X' gives only the maximum. Null otherwise. | | `salary_period` | string, null | year, hour, day, week or month; set together with the amounts. | | `salary_currency` | string, null | GBP when the amounts were read, else null. | | `salary_bands` | array | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Salary band terms the site files the job under (for example '£80,000 - £89,999'). Empty when none. | | `description_short` | string, null | Teaser text of the listing card. | | `description_html` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Full job description as HTML. | | `description_text` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Full job description as plain text. | | `posted_text` | string, null | Age text of the listing card, for example '15 days ago'. Not every card shows it. | | `posted_date_estimated` | string, null | Date worked out from posted_text and the run date (day precision). Exact value: date_posted in detail mode. | | `closing_text` | string, null | Closing text of the listing card: '6 days left' or 'Expiring today'. Not every card shows it. | | `closing_date_estimated` | string, null | Date worked out from closing_text and the run date (day precision). Exact value: valid_through in detail mode. | | `date_posted` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Exact posting time from the job posting data, ISO 8601. | | `valid_through` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Closing time from the job posting data, ISO 8601. | | `is_new` | boolean | True when the card carries the green 'New' badge (added in the last 2 days). | | `is_featured` | boolean | True when the card is a premium (featured) listing. | | `reference` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Advertiser reference. | | `external_job_id` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Id of the job in the advertiser's system, as given in the page data. | | `recruiter_id` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Internal id of the recruiter or employer account, as given in the page data. | | `recruiter_type` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Recruitment Agency or Direct Employer. | | `application_method` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). How applications are taken, for example Email or ExternalRedirect. | | `listing_type` | string, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Listing product of the job, for example 'Job Posting Standard 28 Days'. | | `direct_apply` | boolean, null | Detail mode only (includeDetails). directApply flag of the job posting data. | | `employment_types` | array | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Employment types from the job posting data (TEMPORARY, FULL_TIME, ...). Empty when none. | | `categories` | array | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Sector categories of the job. Empty when none. | | `experience_levels` | array | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Experience levels of the job. Empty when none. | | `contract_types` | array | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Contract type labels (Permanent, Contract, Temporary, Graduate / Internship). Empty when none. | | `hours` | array | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Hours labels (Full Time, Part Time). Empty when none. | | `job_titles` | array | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Standard job title groups of the job. Empty when none. | | `workplaces` | array | Detail mode only (includeDetails). Workplace labels (Remote, Hybrid, On Site). Empty when none. | | `job_url` | string | Job page on GAAPweb. | | `details_fetched` | boolean | True when the job page was read for this row. | | `search_query` | string | The keyword, start URL or 'all jobs' that found the job. | | `source` | string | Source host. | | `scraped_at` | string | Time the row was built, ISO 8601 (UTC). | ## Pricing This Actor uses pay per event. There is a small `apify-actor-start` event when a run starts and one `job-result` event for each job in the dataset. You are never charged for a job twice, and a run stops when it reaches the maximum charge you set. Price: $0.001 start fee per run, then $0.0015 per job result ($1.50 per 1,000 jobs). **New to Apify?** Every account gets a $5 free monthly platform credit, enough to try this actor at no cost. ## Related Actors - [eFinancialCareers Scraper](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/efinancialcareers-scraper): Finance and banking jobs from eFinancialCareers. - [Reed.co.uk Jobs Scraper: UK Jobs & Salaries](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/reed-uk-scraper): UK jobs and salaries from Reed. - [Totaljobs Scraper: UK Jobs, Salaries & Descriptions](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/totaljobs-scraper): UK jobs, salaries and descriptions from Totaljobs. - [JobServe UK Scraper: IT Contract, Engineering, Finance Jobs](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/jobserve-uk-scraper): UK IT contract, engineering and finance jobs from JobServe. ## FAQ **How many jobs can one search return?** A search or the job list shows 30 jobs per page. The actor reads page after page until the site's "Found N jobs" count is reached, the last page is reached, or your limit is reached. The site has about a thousand jobs in total. **Is the posting date exact?** With `includeDetails` on, yes: `date_posted` and `valid_through` come from the job page. With it off, the list shows only an age such as "15 days ago" and a countdown such as "6 days left". `posted_date_estimated` and `closing_date_estimated` are worked out from them and the run date, so they can be off by a day. **Why is the salary parsed for only some jobs?** Advertisers type the salary freely. Texts such as "Competitive" or "Circa £500pd" are returned as `salary_text` only. The numbers `salary_min`, `salary_max`, `salary_period` and `salary_currency` are filled when the text states an amount range and a period (per annum, per hour, per day, per week or per month). **What happens when a keyword finds nothing?** The run ends normally with the status "0 jobs found for ." and nothing is charged for jobs. **What if the site blocks a page?** The site's firewall sometimes answers with an "Error 403" page. The actor retries the page a few times and then once more by another route. If a job page still cannot be read, the row is delivered with its list fields only and the run status says how many job pages were missed. If list pages cannot be read at all, the run ends with a clear "Blocked" status. ## Support Something broken, or a field you wish this Actor returned? Open a ticket on the Actor's [Issues tab](https://apify.com/santamaria-automations/gaapweb-jobs-scraper/issues) or email contact@nanoscrape.com. We usually respond within one working day.
